## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is `feature/*`, `fix/*`, `docs/*` or `chore/*`; commits follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] Only files I own were changed, or the owner agreed / Faqat o'zimga ruxsat berilgan fayllarni o'zgartirdim
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` pass locally / Lokal kompyuterda ishga tushirib ko'rdim
- [ ] Screenshot attached if the UI changed / Ko'rinish o'zgargan bo'lsa skrinshot
- [ ] Contract changed? `docs/api/contracts.md` and `docs/api/openapi.yaml` updated

## Safety checklist (if relevant)

- [ ] No secrets, tokens or real personal data added
- [ ] No legal article, deadline, phone number or procedure is presented as verified without a reviewer
- [ ] AI output is not used to make routing or submission decisions
- [ ] No external submission without explicit user consent; no real government API claimed
